balls.text: Pace-on bouncer beats the pull. 139ks, over off stump, throw from Buttler is in early. Pooran didn't attempt the bye
Ridiculous shot. Pant makes room, Rabada follows with a fullish ball, so the batter gets the had down and to the off side while picking it up with a flick over fine leg

Buttler under-arms a throw at the stumps but the ball spins away as Pant came in. Would've been out by a mile had it hit. Was a slower one, this does bounce but still beats the pull. It was well outside off and Pooran tried to drag it across.
Slower one goes well under the bat. Into the pitch, landed well outside off and angled in. Pooran went for the pull. Too early on it andd too high
Wide yorker, Pant reaches out and jams it to mid-off. Takes off, overthrow might've been on. They won't take it
Mid-off is in and Rabada bowls a full ball. It's a touch wide but well in Pant's arc, he drives it over the infield with ease

Sound there as ball passes bat. Buttler wants to review but GT are out of them. Was a short ball over leg that Pooran tried to pull hard. Was around shoulder-height, head bobbed out the way too. Ultra-Edge shows the noise was from the ball grazing the side of the helmet
Half-tracker and it's been mauled. Pooran gets the front leg out of the way, crouches a bit and pulls the 135ks ball over backward square for an 86-metre six
Loses the bottom hand trying to swat that very low full toss on leg, gets it to deep square leg
Yorker on middle, Pant's beside the line and tries to clip it. Gets it fine off the edge

High ball, Rutherford runs in from deep-backward point and takes a good catch diving forward. Was a length ball that landed around sixth and finished near the off-stump tramline. Marsh went slightly across and tried to launch it over cover, got it off the bottom of the bat. Ends a brilliant 117 with a lot of power-hitting
Marsh's back leg was on fourth stump before the release, so the fullish ball that angled past the slash and went outside the tramline won't be called wide
Shin-high full toss is hit against the angle. It's why Marsh cannot impart power on the drive to long-off.
Prasidh loses his length and Marsh munches it over the sightscreen for a 94-metre six. If that was a missed yorker, it was way off, Marsh drove it with might
Pulled hard, goes well over over deep square leg. Not too short, rises around waist height. Marsh clears the front leg and has the cleanest of horizontal swipes
Wide and full, scythed to deep point to bring up Pooran's fifty.

Wide given, and GT review. Pooran premeditated the paddle, Prasidh went for the wide yorker. It landed outside the tramline and Pooran's right leg went close to the tramline but was it before the ball released? No. And that's why it'll remain a wide

Another yorker attempted. It's just past the crease and Marsh gets it on the low full toss, thrashes it with a big wind-up. Looked to go over long-on, got it to the left of Prasidh. He got a fingertips on it, but it was hit too hard.
Yorker on leg, looks to whip it hard. Toes it to long-on. It's actually between long-on and deep-mid
Goes for the wide yorker, it's a low full toss but he gets away with it. Marsh has to reach out far, doesn't follow through with the slash and gets it to deep cover

Full toss. No-ball called for height. GT review. Was over waist-height as he pulled but the contact point was outside the crease. Ball tracking shows it'd have been well over even if it did travel to the crease. Free hit stays
Marsh brings up his first IPL century by punching it to deep point. Went off the shoulder of the full-faced bat. Second right hander to ton up this season, first overseas batter too
Low fully is muscled over the bowler. Too straight for long-on. Was an attempted yorker on middle

More luck. Short fine was the only infielder on the leg side and this goes well to his right and lands just inside the 30-yard circle. Was a shortish ball that hurried Pooran on the pull to find the top edge
Lucky four through fine leg. Pooran cleared the front leg, opened up wide and tried to slam it over midwicket. He shaved the length ball angling in towards leg stump.
Length on top of middle, whipped off the upper-half of the bat to long-on

Pooran continues to dominate the chat in silence. Holds the shape again after driving over mid-off. Another yorker attempted by Siraj, ends up in front of the crease and allows Pooran to get underneath it. Replay shows Pooran gave the bat a peck in the end there
Pooran's bat does the talking this time, quiet walk back from Siraj. It's a cross-seamer slightly fuller, if at all, than a length. Pooran clears the front leg and slugs it over midwicket.
Another bouncer, this was angling away and Pooran tried to slash it over third from fourth-stump. Misses. More words from Siraj get ignored
Bouncer. On expected lines. It's above middle stump, over head. Let go. Siraj has a quiet word with Pooran, who walked away in silence
Premeditated paddle over short fine. Back leg went outside off early, got a fullish ball going slightly down leg. Pooran leant off side and picked it up cleanly
Full again. It's on off, driven to long-on off the inside-half
Drilled straight of mid-on to get into the nineties. Yorker missed by inches, it's at the stumps, Marsh powers the on-drive and holds his shape
Yorker on leg, worked to long-on
Brave. 96ks on the base of leg stump, Pooran can't get low enough to smear it in the air. Along the ground, to deep midwicket. He'll take the single though
Another seemingly miscued shot sails over long-on. This was a touch short, around off, and Pooran looked like he toed the pull. Doesn't matter in the end.
Wow, Pooran smacks it to long-off and denies a single!. We're truly in match-up ville! Nearly a yorker on middle, on the quicker side, Pooran couldn't get underneath the drive

Fires it wide and Pooran slaps it over cover. 96ks, on a length, close to te off-side tramline, rose around top-of-pad height, Pooran took a big stride towards mid-off and reached out with the upper-body to access it
Length around leg, Marsh makes a lot of room and bunts it through cover
Connects with the hard sweep this time, races along the ground. Tewatia charges to the right, pops to the ball towards long-on running in. Both of them manage to keep it just in.
Gets away with a 98ks full ball that looked loopy. On the pads, Pooran went for the slog sweep, missed it
Length ball spins away after landing well outside off. Let go
Low bounce. Another googly, 100ks, touch short, spinning away through fifth. Goes well under Pooran's pull, bottom hand came off at the end too
Similar ball, this one's the googly spinning in towards top of off. Cut through forward point
Flatter back of lengther on off, 98ks, pulled to long-on
Not if Pooran can help it. Rashid misses on length and Pooran gets on one knee to effectively slog sweep it over long-off
Halfway into the pitch, angles in around the belly. Pulled into the ground and straight to deep fine leg
Pooran misses out on the wide back-of-length ball. Looked to cut hard and square, got beaten
Pushed through cover off the front foot. Prasidh trying the yorker, got it full
Pushes to mid-off for a quick single. Awry throw from Gill is fired almost at Pooran's head. Pooran sways away in time

Marsh was halfway through when Prasidh ran towards cover to pick up the ball. Slide back from the batter, throw's well over the stumps though. Was a length ball around off that Pooran inside edged onto pad while trying to defend
Yorker on middle, might have reversed a touch, jammed to long-on
Rashid drives it into the pitch. Length on fourth, chopped off the bottom-half of the bat to cover
Very unlike Rashid, this is similar to the first ball. Landed around the halfway mark and sat up to arrive just over stump height, Marsh whacks another pull. Front of square, four
Touch short again and it's pulled wide of long-on. Fifth-stump line, Marsh had ample time to rock back and muscle it with extended arms

Second time in the innings a ball that seemed to go straight up clears the deep fielder by a mile. 10 rows long-off this goes. Was a length ball outside off that Marsh seemed to have sliced. Looked like he wanted to go over long-on but all well
Not as short but still enough for the cut to be on. Line was around off but Marsh cleared his front leg to make room and slapped it into the ground
Dragged down first up and Marsh crouches and pulls away over deep midwicket. Likely a googly, spinning in, but it sat up
Slaps it off a length to long-on

Top edge off the pull goes behind. Very fine, halfway into the outfield and rolls for four. Was a short ball outside off that he wanted to drag leg side while being rooted to the crease. 500 runs in the season for Marsh
Quick single to point's right. Soft hands on the angle-bat defence took it slowly. Good ball, three-quarter length in the channel
Length ball angles down leg, goes past the attempted leg glance
Short at the hips, pulled to long leg
Slow fully outside off, slashed with limited timing to cover

Length on middle and leg, quick off the surface, flicked softly through backward square leg. Deep square has to run right, good throw from Arshad. Buttler was a touch casual in collecting the ball to his right, didn't gather it
he starts with a bang! Pitched up, in the arc for Pooran and he gives it a whack straight down, over long-off's head for six. Silences the crowd again

finally a breakthrough for GT and something to scream about for the packed stands! Markram tried to replicate what Marsh did, trying to go for a straight six, but he loses shape a little, doesn't get under it that well and finds long-off right at the edge of the rope. Nicely taken by Shahrukh Khan
tries to swipe that away to leg but not as much bounce and they get a leg bye after he's hit outside leg
outside off and he cuts it away to point

another straight hit from Marsh for six! Sai Kishore goes wide of the crease but all that doesn't matter to Marsh. He stands tall, gets to the pitch of the straight ball and hammers it straight back with some power. Second fifty in a row for Marsh
93.1kmh, darts it in towards the stumps and Markram smashes it back to long off. Reaches him after a bounce
straight down the ground, this won't go all the way, but it lands safe! Markram didn't middle the loft straight back and Shahrukh sprinted in from long on, but it landed just before him

the slower ball is dipping nicely but it's too wide outside off and Markram whacks that over the covers in the gap. Siraj gives it a chase from long off and might have got a hand too but was too late with his slide
almost nails the yorker and Marsh digs it out with hard hands to get one more down the ground
he goes shorter and Marsh dispatches him in the gap on the leg side for four! Marsh is packing a lot of power into his shots, this one bisects the gap between deep midwicket and long on
another good ball! Almost in the block hole, and Markram also gets an inside edge to leg for one
starts with a length ball outside off which Marsh goes after, only manages an edge along the ground to square leg
some width, he scythes it away to deep point for one
91.9kmh, mixes it up with a quicker delivery and Marsh misses the sweep after going down on a knee
takes some pace off for the length ball, he waits and defends it to leg

into the Amdavad sky and then into the sight screen! Initially it looked like Marsh had hit it very high, which he did, but when Siraj gave up near the boundary it meant that he had given it good distance too. Pitched up and lofted straight back for a big six!
a bit more towards leg and he nudges it for a single off the back foot
targets the stumps from wide of the crease, Markram punches it to cover

another appeal that dies quickly and the umpire shakes his head. Well-pitched short ball outside off, it swings away as well as Marsh goes for the pull and some fielders it got something on the way. Buttler points to the shoulder later
short of length and no room, he defends it from in front of the stumps
smoked over deep square leg! There's a fielder waiting there in the deep and Marsh has sent the ball flying right over him, over the shorter boundary for a six to punish the short ball

there's a sound as Marsh goes for another swing on the leg side, the umpire doesn't move after the half-hearted appeal. Gill asks Buttler if there's something but no review taken. not given a wide either so the umpire thinks it was pad and UltraEdge shows no spike. What was the noise then?!
bit more on the leg side and this time he connects with the swipe to send it fine on the leg side, beating short fine leg for four!
anther blow in the abdomen for Marsh! Short of length and angling in, Marsh misses the swipe to leg and this one hit him in the batteries, not the abdomen. Ouch!

was there bat on that? GT appeal and the umpire shows both his hands to ask them to wait. Not given out, review not taken either. It was a short ball towards Markram's shoulder and it went off the shoulder to shirt third after he missed the pull. Looks like the crowd was more excited about it than the GT players
half-volley chipped straight down to long on for one more
another full toss, very close to waist height and Markram looks at the square leg umpire as soon as he pushes it down for a single
oh one more! Rabada goes fuller, it's not half-volley but Markram makes a bit of room and clears his front foot to loft that straight down the ground, over long-on for six more
doesn't make room this time, he stands tall and pulls that shorter delivery right out of the screws over the midwicket rop for six!
low, slow and dipping near-yorker. And the full toss is pushed down to mid on for one

beats him comprehensively to end the over! Siraj banged it in short and with the angle as Markram made room and had a swipe at it. But the ice and bounce gets the better of him as it carries nicely to the keeper
141kmh, cramps him for room by going for top of middle again, defends with a straight bat for one
better length and just outside off, punches that straight to cover
142kmh, errs with the length by going fuller and Marsh cashes in by middling a risk-free straight drive all along the ground, past mid off for four
nice and tight towards the top of middle stump, no room whatsoever and he punches it back
into Markram's abdomen now as Siraj lands it on short of length and there's no time for a run. Marsh is visibly in pain after that blow

a high full toss now. Injuries are having a field day today. This looked above waist height, straight over the stumps, but we'll soon know because LSG have reviewed it as it wasn't given a no-ball. It's just below the recorded waist height of the batter, so a fair delivery
139.6kmh, Rabada follows Markram backing away to make some room, and the back of length ball rams into the batter's abdomen
Rabada replies with a searing yorker on middle now, and Markram digs it out to off
driven back with hard hands and this time Rabada's right hand takes a blow. It goes off the hand and they get one

lofted on the leg side now and this time he connects well enough to send that nearly all the way! A long follow through for the lofted flick as Rabada goes straighter, and he gets a one-bounce boundary
lofted straight down and high, it's not going far but it just about beats a sprinting mid-off while the batters run two
nice and tight to end the over from short of length towards off, and Marsh gets only a single down the ground past a diving Siraj
tighter on middle, he flicks to leg and it reaches Sai Kishore after a bounce

shorter outside off and Marsh slaps it back to Siraj who gets his right hand in the way. He could have injured himself there whether it counts as a drop or not. It was a chance, though, because sometimes those do stick
wild swing across the line to target the leg side. Marsh misses the wide-ish delivery outside off
nipping in sharply from outside off, punches it down to mid on for one more
did that carry to midwicket? Markram pulls to leg and that carried to Sai Kishore who went low to his left and got both hands to it but put it down
pitched up on middle and leg to end the over and it's driven down past Arshad's stretched right hand to mid-on. Arshad is on the ground again, this time while attempting to stop the ball
full on off and Markram drives it down nicely wide of mid-off for one
overcompensates for the width by going for the pads on leg side, and they scamper across for a leg bye
all the way over the covers! Width to Marsh as well, he hardly moves his feet and uses his long reach to send that sailing over the covers boundary. It's the shorter boundary on off this over
no swing again but a tighter line on off stump, punches it down to mid-off where Siraj fumbles while trying to pick that up and he can't save the single
crashed through the covers! Width outside off, no swing and the length is short too, and Markram sends that crashing to the cover point boundary. He's looking in great touch
starts with a wide down the leg side. Some inswing too, so good signs
fuller and straighter to Markram, he drives it down nicely but can't clear mid-on although they manage one more
nice and straight this time around off, Marsh stands tall and pushes it back past the bowler for one. Off the mark
not getting his lines right, Siraj. Sends down a wide well down the leg side
Marsh beaten first ball! That one keeps a little low outside off as Marsh stays back to poke at it, but the lack of bounce surprises him a little
angling in again towards top of leg, Markram tucks it towards mid-on for one
much better from Siraj. Shorter and coming in this time towards the waist, he defends it to leg
starts with a loosener way outside off wit away swing and Markram leans into that nicely to caress that along the ground. Wonderful shot for four!
Another lefty beaten on the slog sweep. Loopy length ball lands on middle and hits leg to complete a 33-run win for LSG against the table-toppers!
Wide and fullish, close to the tramline, Rashid is on one knee slashing to long-off
Slow for a change. Loopy and full, well outside off as Sai Kishore makes room. Chips a drive to long-off
Hirs middle and leg. Fullish ball angled in from wide of the crease. Around the wicket too. Rabada tries to slog it over cow corner, misses
Wide and full, slapped over the bowler. Long-off runs right to keep it to two
Shortish and flat on off, 102ks, pulled to long-on
Single would do too. Yorker just inside the off-side tramline, all Rabada can do is jam it to point. Equation now mathematically beyond GT's reach

Taken at cover and that has to be the game! Avesh continues to go for yorkers, it was a low full toss with the seam pointing towards leg slip. Shahrukh got low and tried to brook it across the line but toed it straight up. He walks back despondent
Clothed again. Rashid is on leg stump heaving across the line, gets the low full toss along the ground to deep square leg
Near yorker on off and Shahrukh can't elevate it. Driven hard, finds long-off
Nails the pace-on yorker on off. Rashid jams the bat on it late, gets it behind point
Goes for the yorker, low full toss it is. Hit to long-on

Watch out for the collision... O'Rourke evades the fielder at point safely. Gets in front and takes the dolly around his chest. Was a wide ball on a shortish length that Arshad tried to drag leg side again. Bottom hand came off as he top-edged the pull
Arshad tries to drag a wide length ball over deep midwicket with a slog sweep. But it's beyond his reach
Another wide. This is shortish, angling away and well past the tramline. Let go
Tight single taken, throw to the bowler is too far down. Was a shortish ball to which Shahrukh danced down and tried to mow across the line. Inside edged it to short fine
Change-up there. Flat and at the stumps, on a length, whipped off the inner-half of the bat to deep square leg
LSG's plan is clear - keep it wide. This one's too far away. The length ball is well past the off-side tramline and beats the slash across the line
Dances down again, bowler goes wide again. Slapped to deep point

Shahbaz deceives Shahrukh but the batter gets lucky. He charged too early, so the bowler went wide and flat on a short length. The batter reached out and tried to slap it with the horizontal bat. Toed it wide of the keeper

O'Rourke might let LSG get away with being a bowler short. Gets Tewatia cheaply with a seam-up length ball on off. Angled in from around the wicket. Tewatia tried to lift it through the line, was too early into it and playing on the up too. Found long-on. Four runs and two wickets
Slot ball, gets away with it. Landed around off and went middle and leg, Shahrukh showed all his stumps, crouched and went with a low, horizontal swing. Got it to long-on
Length over off, clipped to long leg
Shahrukh waits for the high bumper to pass him before launching it over the keeper with the upper cut. Not middled but clears the ring and gets to fifty. Fastest for a GT batter this season
Length on off, defended towards cover point for a quick single

And he strikes first ball! Not a wicket ball as such, the fullish ball angled in towards leg stump from around the wicket. Rutherford was early into the aerial flick, got it right off the toe, Bishnoi came in from deep midwicket to complete the catch
Length outside off, driven to deep square leg

Wide yorker nailed... or not. Wide called, Pant won't review. Replay shows this landed just past the off side tramline and angled away a touch further. Rutherford reached out and tried to scythe it. Beaten
Bouncer let go. One for the over called. Landed very short around leg, ballooned up and went through fifth
Low fully on fourth from wide of the crease, Shahrukh tries to drive through cover. Toes it off the left of the bat. Finds long-on
Change of length and Shahrukh is ready for it. The bouncer is around head height but the bounce is spongy, Shahrukh waits and ramps it over the keeper. Pant isn't happy with the bowler
This is nailed over the bowler! Another slot ball, right on middle stump, and Shahrukh is right behind it. Back leg bends a bit and he drives with ease to hit towards the sightscreen

Thick outside edge sails wide of short third. Well over too. Was an attempted yorker, ended up as a slot ball on fifth. Shahrukh didn't move his feet, wasn't getting his weight into the attempted cover drive but the power took it over the infield
Wide on a length, beats the cut
Reverse swept with the left leg past the off-side tramline. It's like he's a right hander facing a bowler from point and slog sweeping. Sails over third for six
Misfield at cover point, and it beats Pooran running right from sweeper cover. Was a wide length ball that was cut hard. Arshin, the sub, was the fielder

Skied... but it lands safely! Samad ran towards extra cover from long-off, ball landed a few metres past the 30-yard circle. Ball was a touch short and angling away outside off, Rutherford tried to flat bat it, got a top edge
Punches the length ball outside off to cover
Dances down, gets beaten in the air but goes through with the slug across the line. Gets it wide of long-on. Was a length ball, he didn't get to the pitch
Bad ball, whipped behind square. Avesh's fifty is up in three. Line was the issue here, landed down leg, on a fullish length, and Rutherford picked it up with ease
Low fully outside off, inside edge off the cover drive goes onto pad and dribbles towards cover
Shahrukh was walking down, shaping for a leg side shot. Got surprised by a bouncer whizzing close to his chest. He tries to adjust late and ramp over the slips. Misses
Mid-off is in and this is lifted over him for a one-bounce four. Another low fully, on fifth stump, Shahrukh crouches a bit and is able to drive while elevating it
Same length, this is on off, Shahrukh's bat face opens more than he intended as he drives. Ball goes through backward point
Wide yorker missed. It's a low full toss with three deep fielders off side. Shahrukh took a big stride, got on one knee and drove with a flourish. Along the ground through cover

Dropped? There was a sound but not sure if it was bat. Was a wide ball on a length, kept angling away but Rutherford went through with a lofted reverse sweep. Ultra-Edge shows there was a bottom edge! It took the glove and it Pant on the left flank
Length on leg, nudged through midwicket. 92ks
Flat shortish ball wide of off, pulled hard. Goes along the ground, bowler gets a hand on it to take some pace off before it goes to long-on
Slow again, this is a touch fuller and very wide. Shahrukh reaches out and swipes it through cover

O'Rourke takes a couple of steps back from backward point, stops and leaps to try and take an above-head catch with his right hand. It's too high even for him. It rolls a few metres back. Was a wide ball on a shortish length that was cut off the top edge.
Wide on a length, landed close to the tramline and angled away. Let go
93ks. Wide and fullish, slashes it over cover. Clears the infield, stopped close to the boundary
Chance... Badoni charges to the right from backward point and leaps out for a one-hander. Gets hands on it but it doesn't stick. Was a slow shortish ball that Rutherford cut
Goes for the at-the-stumps yorker, lands it full. It's flicked to long-on
Wide ball has been scythed over backward point. Yorker wasn't missed by much, Shahrukh got on one knee to get underneath it and square drive it 67 metres far
No direct hit again. Would've been tight had it hit at the striker's. Was a yorker outside off that was jammed. Replay shows Shahrukh would've made it
Cut hard but timing's not great, finds backward point. Akash seemed to bash the ball into the middle of the pitch but it rose very slowly
Pulled ten rows back. 81 metres over square leg. Just a touch short but it sat up, was around thigh-high and Rutherford had ample time to swivel and launch
Cut early, gets it in the gap through extra cover. Was a back of lengther outside off that was slow off the pitch, ball went off the toe of the bat. Into the grass, outfield is quick

Quick single to mid-off... oh no! Rutherford collides with the bowler three-fourth of the way into the run. Sadly for Samad, the fielder, the throw missed the stumps. Was a full ball angling in towards fourth that was punched firmly
Cut wide of deep third but Avesh manages to run across. Was a spongy back of lengther just outside off
Length on middle and leg, flicked to deep midwicket
Looked slow. Length on leg, tucked towards midwicket
Fullish on the pad, flicked to deep-backward square. 133ks
bowls the slower inswinger that got Buttler, but a watchful SRK waits and punches it back down the ground for a single. Off the mark
swing again, this time late but it's enough to beat SRK's bat
length ball outside off and pushed into the covers

that's the big wickets LSG wanted and an injured Akash Singh has bowled a beauty! A slower inswinger from wide of the crease, it keeps shaping in and goes right through Buttler's push down the ground to knock the stumps over. Akash gives the signature celebration, not quite a send off, and with a smile, unlike Digvesh Rathi who's not playing today
short ball outside off and Rutherford pulls it away for one
starts with a full delivery and Buttler gets one to long off
quicker and into the body, pulled off the inner half to deep fine leg for one and he keeps strike
shorter and slower at 114.6kmh, some width as well outside off, and Buttler stands tall before judging the change of pace and punches it away at the right time for four
pretty full around off, he drives it down nicely for one to long off
angling in sharply, Buttler almost pokes and gets a single to leg off the inner half of the bat
very very risky single to get off the mark! He taps it towards point and takes off, Buttler responds as well but had Himmat hit that direct, Buttler was probably gone
starts with a fullish delivery and Buttler flicks it to leg for one

they've got Gill as well, LSG have sent both GT openers back! Avesh roars and roars, and then pierces the humid air of Ahmedabad with clenched fists. It was pitched up, Gill went down the ground with a straight loft but didn't middled it. It could have even landed short of long off, but Abdul Samad sprinted in and put in a forward dive with perfect timing to gobble it
nearly in the block hole, maybe a couple of inches short outside off, and it's driven away to long off
full on the stumps and Buttler flicks it away along the ground, square of the wicket for two
angles it into the stumps from wide of the crease, helps it along to leg for one
scythed away for four! Really poor ball - short and wide, and Gill brings his bat down with such hard hands and accuracy that he's not going to let this one go
starts with a length ball on the stumps, pushes it down to long on
short and quick on off, he bunts it back to the bowler
short on the stumps, doesn't bounce much and Gill sweeps it late behind square but can't beat short fine leg
Buttler also stays put and nudges this to leg for a single
stays back this time and works the ball to leg for one
crackalicious! The sound of that was like biting into a crisp cracker. Gill came down, Shahbaz pitched it outside off and Gill scythed it away and the ball raced away for four square of the wicket
still towards the pads, it goes fine on the leg side for two. Given runs
starts with one down the leg side, it's a wide
and drills that back after backing away for four more! Avesh goes for the block hole now, Buttler has already shuffled to leg, and the slightly inaccurate yorker is pinged back along the ground
he's reading Avesh like he's a kindergarten book! Backs away this time by anticipating this delivery around off and he lofts that down the ground over long off, gloriously! Top class batting
dances down and smokes it beyond the boundary! Follows the scoop by coming down, he's expecting the shorter length and he pulls that with some muscle
scooped behind the wicket for four! Goes low and across early, he premeditated that and then connected with that very well to take it on the full and middle it behind. Finally off the mark
angling into Buttler, he clips it to leg
outside off and it's driven down the ground for one as it goes off the bowler's hand
excellent end to an excellent over. Nice and tight around off, he defends patiently
he shuffles to off this time and works the ball to leg, but can't clear midwicket
pushes into the off side but the ball takes the inside edge to roll towards midwicket

chipped to mid off, a sharp catch by Markram and GT's opening stand has been broken! Change of pace, change of length, pitched up on off and Sai Sudharsan drives down the ground but he can't keep it down. Even though the ball is dipping on Markram, he does well to dive forward and get his hands under it nicely
short again outside off, and Sai Sudharsan thinks if he can't ride the bounce, it's better to get under it. And he does it nicely by upper cutting it with his wrists, over point for four
short and outside off, not easy to put away and he cuts to point
140.7kmh, tries to bluff the bowler by moving to leg for a flash of a second and then comes back, but Akash Deep sticks to a tight line outside off which Gill can only defend back
too short, too straight, and this one goes away as well. He swipes that down into the ground on the leg side, and behind square, although helped by an under edge
it's the short-arm jab and it's nearly six! Short and into the body, Gill gets on top of it quickly and dispatches it over the long boundary over wide long on
comes down the track and Akash pitches it shorter and into the body, Gill can only nudge that to midwicket
on the pads and clipped away behind square for one
angles this across the batter outside off, Sai Sudharsan chases and misses
angled towards middle and leg from wide of the crease, he clips it to square leg
outside off, Gill dances down again and crashes that through the covers again for four more! Frees his arms on seeing width and middles it
just wide of short midwicket! Shorter length, Gill swats it away on the leg side and Himmat Singh leapt to his right in the circle, but just wasn't in his reach
he charges down for the slightly wide delivery outside off and smacks that all along the carpet, though the covers for four! His first for the night
full just outside off and it's another straight drive from Sai Sudharsan, single to mid on
Gill comes down this time against the left-arm quick, and he punches the short of length ball down to mid off for one
shuffles down to try and negate the swing, drives it nicely down to mid off
past Sai Sudharsan's pads as well and another wide this over
straight on off stump, 133.6kmh, and he punches it to cover
nice and tight outside off, maybe hint of room and Gill pushes it late and wide of backward point for one
his first ball to Gill and it goes down leg, past his pads for a wide
shorter and into the pads again, clipped to leg for one more

lovely use of the straight bat, four down the ground! Some swing from Akash into the batter, but he has adjusted just in time and so well, the he manages to drive it straight back despite the swing and hits it absolutely straight
loud appeal first ball from him for lbw! It goes on and on but that surely pitched outside leg, and the replay confirms that. Pant knew that too and didn't review. It also hit him outside leg
straight again, similar length, and flicks it to leg again
not a poor delivery, except the length perhaps, but this is towards off stump and Sai Sudharsan clips it off the pads with a tiny shuffle, behind square on the leg side for four
swing again to Sai Sudharsan as Akash pitches it shorter this time, the batter looks to cut and only gets an inside edge into the pitch
much tighter with the length ball for Gill, he uses soft hands to push it down to mid off for a quick one. Off the mark as well
another drive off the meat of the bat, this time in the covers for one

it swings, Sai Su drives away from the body and he gets four first ball! Swings away from length outside off and he takes the aerial route as well, but pings it over the covers to start things off in style
